title: filter and find

blocks.md:
## Keep only what you need

`filter` returns every match. `find` returns the first match or `undefined`.

From `["east", "south", "east"]`, keep only `"east"`. Find the first beacon name that starts with `"N"`.

blocks.promptMd: > `onlyEast(dirs)` returns only `"east"` entries, joined as `east,east`. Print that.

hintLadder.md: The starter joins every direction, including the ones you were asked to drop.
`filter` keeps the entries whose test returns true and returns a new, shorter list.
`dirs.filter((d) => d === "east")` keeps only the easts; `join(",")` then makes the line.

description: Keep the items that match, or find the first one that does.
